conversations.say: Morgan, regarding your request to date the pattern change: I have the transaction continuity details, but I need your binding confirmation on customer attribution limits before you look at anything.
conversations.offer: A bounded view of the ledger timing and collector timelines.
conversations.request: A firm agreement in writing that you will not attach specific customer names or expose our local arrangements as R.

conversations.say: Graham, you offered to settle my shop's account balance, but I am not handing over raw ledger patterns so you can play market games with neighborhood history.
conversations.offer: To discuss a strictly limited, non-dramatized summary of ordinary counter traffic.
conversations.request: Upfront financial settlement of the overdue account and an explicit promise not to publish speculative fiction from our records.

conversations.say: Inez, outside interests are circling the bodega books hard. We need to lock down our mutual protection boundary so no one can pressure us about past favors or altered entries.
conversations.offer: My ongoing silence and local solidarity regarding our service routines and off-book arrangements.
conversations.request: Your active backing if outsiders try to paint my shop records as part of their conspiracy theories.

public_statement: If anyone thinks a grocery tab and a delivery receipt are cryptographic keys to fifteen years of mystery, come down to the counter and let's read the prices together before you invent a ghost.

commitments.promise: Mutual defense of neighborhood privacy and resistance against outside exploitation of counter records.
Provide bounded ledger access only under strict customer privacy and non-attribution terms.

goal_progress: Engaged Morgan with strict terms on ledger viewing and attribution limits.
Resisted Graham's attempt to exploit raw ledger patterns for market speculation while demanding debt settlement.
Reinforced privacy boundary with Inez to protect local customers and shop records.
reasoning_summary: Rafi maintains a guarded, transactional posture, demanding clear guarantees and debt settlement from Morgan and Graham while reinforcing community protection agreements with Inez.
